subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an internal `rescueWatchdog` cron payload and unattended managed-service repair path once the branch is rebased, repaired, and proven live?
rationale: The code blockers are concrete, but the permanent product/security boundary for an unattended core repair watchdog is a maintainer choice, not a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current main, fixes the protocol/persistence/command regressions, and adds redacted live recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into the broader watchdog issue
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/36314 as the canonical design thread and pause this branch until the broader recovery model is approved.

options.title: Close in favor of a new narrow PR
options.body: Ask for a fresh smaller PR if the current stale branch is no longer worth repairing across current cron, protocol, daemon, and gateway surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current main, fixes the protocol/persistence/command regressions, and adds redacted live recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently carried the current cron/protocol/persistence surfaces that determine whether the rescue payload can merge safely.
